scanNote: Skanning paytida betning o'ng chekkasi biroz kesilgan — xat matnining bir necha qatori oxiri to'liq ko'rinmaydi. Matn kontekstdan to'liq tiklandi (gaplar tugallangan va ma'nosi bir xil), 3-mashq javoblari bilan ham tekshirildi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Who's Tony's father? mother? grandfather? grandmother? sister? brother?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang. Tonining otasi kim? onasi? bobosi? buvisi? singlisi? ukasi?
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — OILA.

Sarlavha 'Like Father, like Son' — inglizcha maqol.
So'zma-so'z: 'Ota qanday bo'lsa, o'g'il ham shunday.'
Ma'nosi: bola ota-onasiga o'xshaydi.
O'zbekchada: 'Olma daraxtidan uzoqqa tushmaydi.'

OILA A'ZOLARI:
  father / dad       — ota
  mother / mum       — ona
  parents            — ota-ona
  grandfather / grandad — bobo
  grandmother / granny  — buvi
  grandparents       — bobo va buvi
  brother            — aka yoki uka
  sister             — opa yoki singil
  son                — o'g'il
  daughter           — qiz

DIQQAT: ingliz tilida AKA va UKA farqlanmaydi — ikkalasi ham 'brother'.
Kerak bo'lsa 'older brother' (katta aka) yoki 'younger brother' (uka)
deb aniqlashtiriladi. Opa/singil ham shunday: 'sister'.

answers.descEn: Picture 1 — the man standing on the left. He is Tony's father.
Picture 2 — the older man with white hair standing on the right. He is Tony's grandfather.
answers.descUz: 2-rasm: o'ngda turgan oq sochli keksa erkak — Tonining bobosi

answers.descEn: Picture 3 — the woman sitting on the left. She is Tony's mother.
Picture 4 — the girl in the dark dress. She is Tony's sister, aged nine.
answers.descUz: 4-rasm: to'q rangli ko'ylakdagi qiz — Tonining to'qqiz yoshli singlisi

answers.descEn: Picture 5 — the little boy in dungarees. He is Tony's brother, aged six.
answers.descUz: 5-rasm: kombinezondagi kichkina bola — Tonining olti yoshli ukasi

answers.descEn: Picture 6 — the fair-haired woman standing on the right. She is Tony's grandmother.
answers.descUz: 6-rasm: o'ngda turgan sariq sochli ayol — Tonining buvisi

answers.descEn: Tony — the teenage boy in the dark jumper on the right.
answers.descUz: Toni — o'ngdagi to'q rangli sviterdagi o'smir

exercises.instructionEn: Describe the people in the picture.
exercises.explanationUz:
Unit 2 da o'rganilgan odam tasvirlash tili qayta ishlatiladi.

QOLIP:
  X is + yosh/bo'y sifati + WITH + soch/ko'z.
  Joe is tall with short dark hair.

KERAKLI SO'ZLAR:
  bo'y:  tall (baland), short (past)
  gavda: slim (nozik), fat (to'la)
  yosh:  young (yosh), old (keksa), middle-aged (o'rta yoshli)
  soch:  short/long, dark/fair/grey/white, straight/curly
  ko'z:  brown, blue, green eyes

DIQQAT — 'hair' HECH QACHON ko'plikda ishlatilmaydi:
  ✅ short dark hair
  ❌ short dark hairs

example.en: Tony is tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
example.uz: Toni baland bo'yli va nozik, sochi kalta va to'q rangli, ko'zlari jigarrang.

modelSentences.sentence: Joe is Tony's father. He is middle-aged and tall with short dark hair.
modelSentences.uz: Jou — Tonining otasi. U o'rta yoshli va baland bo'yli, sochi kalta va to'q rangli.

modelSentences.sentence: Kate is Tony's mother. She is middle-aged with short fair hair.
modelSentences.uz: Keyt — Tonining onasi. U o'rta yoshli, sochi kalta va sariq.

modelSentences.sentence: Steve is Tony's grandfather. He is old and tall with short white hair.
modelSentences.uz: Stiv — Tonining bobosi. U keksa va baland bo'yli, sochi kalta va oq.

modelSentences.sentence: Sally is Tony's grandmother. She has got long fair hair.
modelSentences.uz: Salli — Tonining buvisi. Uning sochi uzun va sariq.

modelSentences.sentence: Liz is Tony's sister. She is nine years old and she has got long dark hair.
modelSentences.uz: Liz — Tonining singlisi. U to'qqiz yoshda, sochi uzun va to'q rangli.

modelSentences.sentence: Leo is Tony's brother. He is six years old and he is small with short fair hair.
modelSentences.uz: Leo — Tonining ukasi. U olti yoshda, kichkina, sochi kalta va sariq.

exercises.instructionEn: First read the sentences, then listen and underline the correct word.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglab, to'g'ri so'zni tanlang.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor. Barcha javoblarni 4-mashqdagi Tonining xatidan ham topish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
TINGLASHDAN OLDIN gaplarni o'qish — Enterprise usuli.
Shunda audio tushunarli bo'ladi.

Bu yerdagi juftlar juda o'xshash eshitiladi — diqqat bilan:
  Montreal /ˌmɒntriˈɔːl/  ↔  Madrid /məˈdrɪd/
  seventy  /ˈsevnti/       ↔  seven /ˈsevn/  ← eng chalkash!
  surgeon  /ˈsɜːdʒən/      ↔  teacher
  hospital ↔ school
  cinema   ↔ theatre

SON QOIDASI — 13 va 30 tipidagi juftlar:
  seven /ˈsevn/    — ikki bo'g'in, urg'u birinchi
  seventy /ˈsevnti/ — uch bo'g'in, oxirida /ti/
Oilada 70 kishi bo'lishi mumkin emas — mantiq ham yordam beradi!

items.whyUz: Xatda: 'I live in Montreal, Canada.' Manzil ham Montreal, Kanada.

items.textEn: b  There are ____ of us in our family.
items.whyUz: Xatda: 'There are seven of us in our family' — bobo, buvi, ota, ona, singil, uka va Toni = 7.
Xatda: 'My father is a surgeon.' surgeon = jarroh. Ona esa o'qituvchi.

items.textEn: d  He works at the local ____ .
items.whyUz: Jarroh kasalxonada ishlaydi: 'He works at the local hospital.'

items.textEn: e  I don't like going to the ____ .
items.whyUz: Xatda: 'I also like going to the cinema... I don't like going to the theatre, though.' Kinoni YOQTIRADI, teatrni yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Pierre has got a letter. It's from his new pen-friend, Tony.
exercises.instructionUz: Pyer xat oldi. U yangi qalamkash do'sti Tonidan.
exercises.explanationUz:
PEN-FRIEND — qalamkash do'st: xat orqali tanishadigan,
odatda boshqa mamlakatdagi do'st.

XATNING YUQORI O'NG BURCHAGIDA — YOZUVCHINING MANZILI.
Bu britan xat yozish qoidasi. Manzil tartibi:
  1) uy raqami va ko'cha
  2) shahar va viloyat
  3) pochta indeksi
  4) mamlakat

  43, St Catherine Street
  Montreal, PQ
  M3B 2Y7
  Canada

  PQ — Province of Quebec (Kvebek viloyati)
  M3B 2Y7 — Kanada pochta indeksi (harf va raqam aralash)

MONTREAL — Kanadaning Kvebek viloyatidagi katta shahar.
U yerda ingliz va FRANSUZ tillari ishlatiladi — shuning uchun
Tonining do'sti fransuzcha ismli: Pierre (Pyer).

sentences.en: 43, St Catherine Street
sentences.uz: Sent-Ketrin ko'chasi, 43-uy
sentences.noteUz: St = Saint (Avliyo). Uy raqami birinchi, vergul bilan.

sentences.en: Montreal, PQ
sentences.uz: Monreal, Kvebek viloyati
sentences.noteUz: PQ = Province of Quebec.

sentences.en: M3B 2Y7
sentences.uz: Pochta indeksi
sentences.noteUz: Kanada indeksi 6 belgidan iborat: harf-raqam-harf, bo'sh joy, raqam-harf-raqam.

sentences.en: Canada
sentences.uz: Kanada
sentences.noteUz: Mamlakat oxirida yoziladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read Tony's letter and explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Tonining xatini o'qing va qalin yozilgan so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
XAT TUZILISHI (4 xatboshi):
  1) O'zi haqida: ism, yosh, kasb, tashqi ko'rinish
  2) Oilasi: kim bor, ota-onaning kasbi, uy
  3) Bo'sh vaqti: nimani yoqtiradi, nimani yoqtirmaydi
  4) Yakun: javob so'rash

Bu tuzilma o'zingiz haqingizda yozish uchun ham NAMUNA.
Qalin so'zlar — 4c mashqida tushuntirilishi kerak bo'lgan so'zlar.

sentences.en: Dear Pierre,
sentences.uz: Hurmatli Pyer,
sentences.noteUz: Do'stona xat boshi. Ismdan keyin VERGUL qo'yiladi (nuqta emas).

sentences.en: I'm Tony Philips and I'm seventeen years old.
sentences.uz: Men Toni Filipsman va o'n yetti yoshdaman.
sentences.noteUz: Yosh: 'I'm 17 years old' yoki qisqacha 'I'm 17'. 'I have 17 years' NOTO'G'RI.

sentences.en: I'm a student and I live in Montreal, Canada.
sentences.uz: Men talabaman va Monrealda, Kanadada yashayman.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'Z: live = yashamoq. Shahar va mamlakat bilan IN.

sentences.en: I'm tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
sentences.uz: Men baland bo'yli va nozikman, sochim kalta va to'q rangli, ko'zlarim jigarrang.
sentences.noteUz: Tashqi ko'rinish qolipi: I'm + sifat + WITH + soch va ko'z.

sentences.en: There are seven of us in our family; my grandparents, Steve and Sally, my parents, Joe and Kate, my sister, Liz, aged nine, my brother, Leo, aged six, and of course, me.
sentences.uz: Oilamizda yetti kishimiz: bobom va buvim Stiv va Salli, ota-onam Jou va Keyt, to'qqiz yoshli singlim Liz, olti yoshli ukam Leo va, albatta, men.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: grandparents = bobo va buvi; parents = ota-ona; aged = ...yoshli; of course = albatta.
Nuqtali vergul (;) ro'yxatni boshlaydi.

sentences.en: My father is a surgeon.
sentences.uz: Otam jarroh.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'Z: surgeon = jarroh (operatsiya qiluvchi shifokor). Kasb oldida 'a' SHART.

sentences.en: He works at the local hospital and my mother is a teacher in a primary school.
sentences.uz: U mahalliy kasalxonada ishlaydi, onam esa boshlang'ich maktabda o'qituvchi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: local hospital = mahalliy kasalxona; primary school = boshlang'ich maktab (5–11 yosh).
'work AT' — muassasada ishlamoq.

sentences.en: We live in a big house about twenty minutes from the city centre.
sentences.uz: Biz shahar markazidan taxminan yigirma daqiqa masofadagi katta uyda yashaymiz.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: city centre = shahar markazi.
'about' = taxminan. Masofa VAQT bilan ham o'lchanadi.

sentences.en: In my free time, I love playing computer games and listening to rock music.
sentences.uz: Bo'sh vaqtimda kompyuter o'yinlari o'ynashni va rok musiqa tinglashni yaxshi ko'raman.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: free time = bo'sh vaqt.
MUHIM: 'love/like' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi: love PLAYING, like LISTENING.

sentences.en: I'm an MTV maniac.
sentences.uz: Men MTV ishqibozi (jinnisi) man.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: maniac = biror narsaga o'ta berilgan odam.
MTV — musiqa telekanali. 'an MTV' — 'em-ti-vi' unli tovush bilan boshlanadi.

sentences.en: My favourite group is Guns'n'Roses. Do you like them?
sentences.uz: Eng sevimli guruhim — Guns'n'Roses. Sen ularni yoqtirasanmi?
sentences.noteUz: 'them' — obyekt olmoshi (1-epizodda o'rganildi).

sentences.en: I also like going to the cinema. I go to the cinema every Saturday.
sentences.uz: Yana kinoga borishni yoqtiraman. Har shanba kinoga boraman.
sentences.noteUz: 'also' = yana, shuningdek. 'every Saturday' = har shanba.

sentences.en: I don't like going to the theatre, though.
sentences.uz: Teatrga borishni esa yoqtirmayman.
sentences.noteUz: 'though' gap OXIRIDA — 'lekin, esa' ma'nosida. Og'zaki nutqda ko'p ishlatiladi.

sentences.en: Well, that's all about me.
sentences.uz: Xo'sh, men haqimda shuncha.
sentences.noteUz: Xatni yakunlashga o'tish iborasi.

sentences.en: Write back and tell me about yourself.
sentences.uz: Javob yozing va o'zingiz haqingizda gapirib bering.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: write back = javob yozmoq; yourself = o'zing.
Ikkalasi ham BUYRUQ shaklida (1-epizod grammatikasi).

sentences.en: Best wishes, Tony
sentences.uz: Ezgu tilaklar bilan, Toni
sentences.noteUz: Do'stona xat oxiri. Vergul, keyin yangi qatorda ism.

exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL TURLARI:

  'What does X look like?' — TASHQI KO'RINISH so'raladi.
  DIQQAT: 'What is X like?' — XARAKTER yoki umumiy tavsif.
  Farqi:
    What does he look like? — He is tall with dark hair. (ko'rinishi)
    What is he like?        — He is kind and funny. (xarakteri)

  'What does X like doing?' — nimani yoqtiradi.
  Bu yerda 'like' — 'yoqtirmoq' fe'li (kabi emas!).

items.answer: He is tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
items.whyUz: Xatning birinchi xatboshisidan. 'look like' — tashqi ko'rinish.

items.answer: She is a teacher in a primary school.
items.whyUz: Xatda: 'my mother is a teacher in a primary school'.

items.answer: It is in Montreal, Canada, about twenty minutes from the city centre.
items.whyUz: Manzil: 43, St Catherine Street, Montreal. Xatda: 'about twenty minutes from the city centre'.

items.answer: He likes playing computer games, listening to rock music and going to the cinema.
items.whyUz: Uchta mashg'ulot. 'like' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi.

items.textEn: 4  What does Tony not like doing?
items.answer: He doesn't like going to the theatre.
items.whyUz: Xatda: 'I don't like going to the theatre, though.'
Do'stona xat 'Dear + ism' bilan boshlanadi.
Do'stona xat 'Best wishes' yoki 'Love' bilan tugaydi.

exercises.explanationUz: Xatdagi 13 ta qalin so'z — Unit 4 ning asosiy lug'ati.

items.whyUz: I live in Montreal.
grand + parents. Bitta so'z bilan aytiladi.
Doim ko'plikda. Bittasi — 'a parent'.
my sister, Liz, aged nine — to'qqiz yoshli singlim Liz.
Ikki so'z. 'ofkos' deb o'qiladi.
Operatsiya qiladigan shifokor. O'qilishi 'SO-jen'.
local = o'sha joydagi, mahalliy.
5–11 yoshdagilar uchun. Keyingisi — secondary school.
AQShda 'downtown' deyiladi.
'spare time' ham deyiladi.
an MTV maniac — MTV ishqibozi. Salbiy emas, hazil ohangda.
'back' — javoban degani. call back = qayta qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.
self olmoshi. myself, yourself, himself, herself...

groups.ruleUz: grand- oldi qo'shimchasi — bir avlod uzoq
groups.explanationUz: 'grand-' qo'shilsa, qarindoshlik bir avlod uzoqlashadi. 'great-' qo'shilsa — yana bir avlod.
Bu fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING qo'shimchasini oladi. Bu Unit 4 ning asosiy grammatikasi.
'O'zim, o'zing, o'zi' ma'nosini beradi. Ega bilan to'ldiruvchi bir xil odam bo'lganda ishlatiladi.
Bu betdagi kasblar. Kasb oldida DOIM a/an turadi.
Fe'lga 'back' qo'shilsa, 'javob sifatida' ma'nosi paydo bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: O'zi va oilasi haqida yozish qoliplari.

patterns.formula: I'm + ism and I'm + yosh + years old.
patterns.exampleEn: I'm Tony Philips and I'm seventeen years old.
patterns.exampleUz: Men Toni Filipsman va o'n yetti yoshdaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
Yosh 'BE' fe'li bilan aytiladi: I AM 17.
'I have 17 years' — NOTO'G'RI (bu o'zbek/rus tilidan ta'sir).

patterns.formula: I'm + bo'y/gavda + WITH + soch + and + ko'z.
patterns.exampleEn: I'm tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
patterns.exampleUz: Men baland bo'yli va nozikman, sochim kalta va to'q rangli, ko'zlarim jigarrang.
patterns.explanationUz:
Tartib: bo'y → gavda → WITH → soch → ko'z.
'hair' birlikda, 'eyes' ko'plikda.

patterns.formula: There are + son + of us in our family.
patterns.exampleEn: There are seven of us in our family.
patterns.explanationUz: 'of us' — 'bizdan'. Oila a'zolari sonini aytishning tabiiy usuli.
Qisqa tanishtirish. Ism ikki vergul orasida, keyin 'aged + son'.

patterns.exampleEn: He works at the local hospital.
patterns.explanationUz:
Muassasa bilan AT: at the hospital, at the school, at a bank.
Muassasa TURINI aytganda IN: a teacher IN a primary school.

patterns.formula: In my free time, I love/like + fe'l-ING.
patterns.exampleEn: In my free time, I love playing computer games and listening to rock music.
patterns.exampleUz: Bo'sh vaqtimda kompyuter o'yinlari o'ynashni va musiqa tinglashni yaxshi ko'raman.
patterns.explanationUz:
like/love/enjoy dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi.
  ✅ I like going.   ❌ I like go.   ❌ I like to going.

patterns.exampleEn: I don't like going to the theatre, though.
patterns.explanationUz:
'though' gap oxirida — oldingi fikrga qarshi ma'no qo'shadi.
Oldidan vergul qo'yiladi.
